evals.prompt: 把当前 plan 拆成两个可独立验收的纵向 Ticket。
evals.expected_output: Creates two narrow Ticket contracts with observable AC, typed dependencies and section-level contract references.
expectations: Does not split by file layer
References only relevant major headings rather than whole contract documents

evals.prompt: plan 已经声明 tickets=true，请创建 Ticket。
evals.expected_output: Creates only Ticket contracts under the current Attempt and does not create a Task/DAG bundle.

evals.prompt: 创建 Ticket 时把来源统一写成 spec.md 和 contract-design.md 就行，后续 agent 自己全文搜索。
evals.expected_output: Rejects document-wide contract pointers and records repository-relative references to the relevant major headings only.
expectations: Does not copy contract prose into the Ticket
Keeps unrelated contract sections out of the Ticket context

evals.prompt: 当前 Ticket 需要引用 contract-design.md 里很大的 ‘Canonical persistence model’ 一节中的某个 Aggregate。
evals.expected_output: Cites the section anchor plus the specific Aggregate name as the entry point rather than the whole section.
expectations: Includes both the section anchor and a named entry point (Operation/Aggregate/Seam/Projection or symbol name)
Does not cite the whole contract-design.md section without naming the entry point
Does not copy contract prose into the Ticket
